import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival Rate by Class and Sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B9D', '#4A90E2'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age Distribution by Survival Status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Survival Count by Embarkation Port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().reset_index(name='count')
embark_survival = embark_survival[embark_survival['embark_town'].notna()]
embark_pivot = embark_survival.pivot(index='embark_town', columns='survived', values='count').fillna(0)
embark_pivot.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], width=0.6)
ax3.set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Port and Survival', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'], loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class with Survival Overlay
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for cls in ['First', 'Second', 'Third']:
    class_data = df[df['class'] == cls]
    survived_data = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare'].dropna()
    died_data = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare'].dropna()
    
class_colors = {'First': '#FFD700', 'Second': '#C0C0C0', 'Third': '#CD7F32'}
for i, cls in enumerate(['First', 'Second', 'Third']):
    class_survived = df[(df['class'] == cls) & (df['survived'] == 1)]['fare'].dropna()
    class_died = df[(df['class'] == cls) & (df['survived'] == 0)]['fare'].dropna()
    
    positions = [i*2, i*2+0.8]
    bp = ax4.boxplot([class_died, class_survived], positions=positions, widths=0.6,
                      patch_artist=True, showfliers=False,
                      boxprops=dict(facecolor=class_colors[cls], alpha=0.7),
                      medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2))

ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticks([0.4, 2.4, 4.4])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add custom legend for survival status
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='gray', alpha=0.7, label='Died'),
                   Patch(facecolor='gray', alpha=0.7, label='Survived')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right', title='Status')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
